data.name: The Real Americans - Roughneck Rumble
data.detailed_description:
The streamers are hung, the candles lit, and the suspiciously overcooked casserole is cooling. IT MUST BE GRANNY BETTY’S BIRTHDAY! But nothing ruins a birthday shinding like a never-ending onslaught of dastardly martians. Your mission: Lock, load, and decimate every martian in sight. And for the love of all that’s holy, don’t let them touch that casserole.

Roughneck Rumble is a high-octane third-person wave shooter set in a gritty, sun-drenched wasteland.

  • Action-Packed Mechanics: Scavenge for resources, aim with precision, and blast through relentless hordes of enemies across a variety of dusty, atmospheric environments.

  • Tactical Survival: Manage your ammo and health in real-time as you navigate treacherous junk-yards and outback outposts.

  • The Ultimate Challenge: Progress through increasingly difficult combat waves that test your reflexes and positioning.

Whether you're holding the line at Betty’s Bar or sniping from behind a stack of rusted cars, the core appeal is simple: stay mobile, stay armed, and survive the rumble.

data.short_description: Roughneck Rumble is a wave-based shooter where you play as the Badger family, grabbing whatever guns you can find and trying to survive a nonstop Martian invasion.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / GTX 1650 or AMD RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
